## Image Loader 0.7.0

Version 0.7 fixes the photo-conversion freeze, reduces high-resolution image memory usage, simplifies Gallery Mode, and makes Exact RGB pixels reusable blocks.

### Critical fix

- Fixed an inner conversion loop regression that never advanced its X coordinate. Converting any loaded photo could lock the main thread indefinitely and appear to crash tModLoader.

### Image loading optimizations

- Validates PNG/JPEG dimensions before handing image data to the native graphics decoder.
- Rejects decompression-bomb dimensions above 8 megapixels or 8192 pixels per side with a menu error.
- Keeps the full-resolution image only as CPU conversion data.
- Creates a menu-sized GPU thumbnail instead of retaining a full 1080p/4K preview texture.
- Samples alpha statistics with a bounded workload on large sources.
- Guarantees the temporary decode texture is disposed on the main thread after thumbnail creation.

### Exact RGB blocks

- Breaking an Exact RGB pixel drops a real item that stores the pixel colour.
- RGB block item names show their exact value, for example `RGB 248, 34, 230`.
- Placing the dropped item restores its original colour.
- RGB item colour data saves, clones, and synchronizes in multiplayer.

### Gallery Mode

- Gallery zoom is clamped to 100%–400%.
- Ctrl + wheel can zoom in and return toward 100%, but cannot zoom beyond the normal viewport.
- Page Down / Gallery Zoom Out has been removed.
- Removed the unreliable expanded tile-render-bounds hook.
- Added a bright local light around the hidden player/camera position.
- Gallery flight, noclip, invulnerability, hidden-player view, zoom-in, and the persistent zoom label remain.

### Removed

- Schematic Mode and its screenshot tile-recognition service.

### Compatibility

Built and compiled against Terraria 1.4.4.9 with the tModLoader 2026.08 preview line.
